# DonorPerfect Downsides

Based on user reviews and common feedback, here are the main drawbacks of DonorPerfect:

## **User Interface & Usability**
- **Outdated interface** - Many users find the design feels dated compared to modern software
- **Steep learning curve** - Can be difficult for new users to master
- **Not intuitive** - Navigation and workflows aren't always logical

## **Reporting & Data**
- **Limited reporting flexibility** - Standard reports can be rigid; custom reports require technical knowledge
- **Report builder complexity** - Creating custom reports is challenging without training
- **Data export limitations** - Getting data out in desired formats can be cumbersome

## **Technical Issues**
- **Slow performance** - Can lag, especially with larger databases
- **Occasional glitches** - Users report bugs and system errors
- **Search functionality** - Not always efficient or user-friendly

## **Cost Concerns**
- **Price increases** - Some users report unexpected or significant cost hikes
- **Add-on costs** - Many features require additional paid modules
- **Value for smaller organizations** - May be expensive for the features small nonprofits actually use

## **Support & Training**
- **Variable customer service** - Quality of support can be inconsistent
- **Training required** - Often need paid training to use effectively
- **Implementation time** - Can take significant time to set up properly

## **Integration & Flexibility**
- **Limited integrations** - Fewer third-party connections than some competitors
- **Customization constraints** - Not as flexible as some organizations need

Would you like to know about alternatives or specific aspects of DonorPerfect?
